purpose: Teach: 交信/逆説/マニフェスト/点在/入港/強者/待合室/首席

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: リモート社員との交信頻度を上げましょう
lines.en: Let's increase our communication frequency with remote staff.
lines.style: Brisk, matter-of-fact tone. Clipped consonants. Forward momentum from one idea to the next. The cadence of someone moving through a list with clear purpose.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。逆説的アプローチも提案します
lines.en: Yes — I can also propose a paradoxical approach to that.
lines.style: Responsive and alert. Slight lift on "paradoxical" — showing he's thinking ahead. Warm but efficient. The tempo of someone keeping pace with their colleague's momentum.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新商品マニフェストを公表しましょう
lines.en: Let's release the new product manifesto to the public.
lines.style: Clear, confident direction. Slight emphasis on "release." Measured pace. The voice of someone who has thought this through and is now moving the team forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。販売店が全国に点在しています
lines.en: Yes — our retailers are scattered across the nation.
lines.style: Steady, informational tone. Slight weight on "nation" — grounding the scope. Calm, professional. The delivery of someone providing context without hedging.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 輸入品の入港スケジュールを共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share the import shipment arrival schedule with everyone.
lines.style: Direct, purposeful. Crisp attack on the opening word. Clean pacing. The tone of a leader who expects action from this point.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の強者と渡り合います
lines.en: Yes — we'll hold our own against the industry leaders.
lines.style: Confident undertone beneath the compliance. Slight lean forward on "our own." Steady eye contact in the voice. The assurance of someone who believes in what they're saying.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 受付の待合室を新装しましょう
lines.en: Let's renovate the reception waiting area.
lines.style: Clear directive. Even tempo. Professional but not cold. The voice of someone moving through necessary improvements with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業所首席のリーダーを集めます
lines.en: Yes — I'll gather the regional sales leaders together.
lines.style: Closing note: slightly lower in the register, gathering the threads. Warm underlying commitment. The steady finish of someone who will follow through.
